verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's docs index lists a first-party Mission Control Agent for investigating your environment and making supported changes, which is a built-in assistant you can delegate tasks to. However, the only evidence is a single one-line mention, so the scope of supported changes is unproven. missing for 10: detailed documentation of which tasks the agent can perform and how users invoke it in the Cloud Console, approval and guardrail controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works.
